user_scope_clarification: All destination addresses are Kazakhstan; Kyrgyz/Uzbek/Tajik/Mongolian describe user languages, not destination countries.

geographic_reference.source: Local Kazakhstan KATO/OSM only; no foreign gazetteer

supervision_policy.split_policy: Keep all variants, shared original source families and language versions of one base in the same partition.

authoring_methods.base: Composition from previously LLM-labelled Kazakhstan district examples with preserved origin/family; literal country and delivery instruction additions.
authoring_methods.ky: Literal LLM-authored/labelled Kazakhstan examples with Kyrgyz vocabulary.
authoring_methods.uz: Literal LLM-authored/labelled Kazakhstan examples with Uzbek vocabulary.
authoring_methods.tg: Literal LLM-authored/labelled Kazakhstan examples with Tajik vocabulary.
authoring_methods.mn: LLM-declared Kazakhstan components rendered with authored Mongolian patterns; label roles known from typed construction, not parser inference.
